description: Investors withdrew a record $7.1 billion from U.S. investment-grade bond funds. Surging oil prices and rising Treasury yields triggered this sharp selloff. High-yield bond funds and leveraged-loan funds attracted modest inflows during the same week. These alternative fixed-income segments are less sensitive to rising yields. The market reflects investor preferences for resilience amid inflation concerns.

title: Global Markets: Japan's Nikkei rises as oil falls before key earnings
description: Japan's Nikkei share average closed higher on Monday, boosted by lower oil prices. Investors remained cautious due to upcoming major earnings reports from U.S. cloud companies. Reduced concerns over crude prices supported Japanese shares, while buybacks were also anticipated. Major U.S. and Japanese companies will release their earnings this week. Chip-testing equipment maker Advantest and memory chipmaker Kioxia are among those reporting.

title: Global Market: Singapore Central Bank surprises markets with policy tightening amid inflation risks
description: Singapore's central bank unexpectedly tightened monetary policy on Monday. Persistent inflation risks from elevated energy costs prompted the move. The Monetary Authority of Singapore will slightly increase its exchange rate appreciation. This surprise decision boosted the Singapore dollar against the US dollar. Economists view this as a preventive step against future price pressures.

title: Sunil Singhania adds two new stocks in Q1 that have risen up to 93% in 2026. Do you own any?

Abakkus also boosted its positions in Arvind Fashions and Cyient DLM. Holdings were reduced in five other companies, with likely exits noted. This activity reflects the veteran investor's ongoing portfolio adjustments and market strategy.

title: Canara Bank Q1 Results: Net profit rises 2% YoY to Rs 4,856 crore; NII jumps 13%
description: Canara Bank Q1 Results: State-owned Canara Bank reported a 2% YoY rise in Q1 FY27 net profit to Rs 4,856 crore, while net interest income (NII) grew 13% to Rs 10,216 crore. Asset quality improved sharply, with total NPAs declining nearly 24% YoY to Rs 1,399 crore. Total provisions also eased, reflecting continued improvement in the bank's overall balance sheet strength.
